'''Xandu''' were four-winged, six-eyed, [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Xandu2.png|thumb|left|180px|A xandu taking Anakin Skywalker for a ride]]
The [[Bat/Legends|batlike]]<ref name="CWCE" /> Xandu had a physiology that seemed to incorporate both [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and bat characteristics. They had a large head with fanged mouth, six [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and large protruding [[Ear/Legends|ears]] that could pick up signals of prey from a distance. Their body appeared somewhat humanoid in that it had a torso, with two thin arm and leg appendages. From the back of the arms were two wings which provided them with the ability to fly. There were two more wing-like formations protruding from each leg. These "wings" did not appear to be critical to the xandu's ability to fly.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> They would snatch prey in their talons, and dash it against rocks.<ref name="CWCE" />

==History==
During their search for an antidote to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] encountered a xandu while climbing down a cliff wall to obtain [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] root, the key ingredient. Skywalker was able to leap from the cliff face and grab hold of one of the xandu's legs. Kenobi then grabbed the other leg and their combined weight seemed to force the xandu's descent to the canyon floor.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, the xandu appearing in the episode was to have been devoured by the [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] vines.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
